apaya.prompt: Inside a cozy brick-walled coffee shop in Frederick, Maryland, warm natural morning light, a phone on a small stand photographs a fresh latte and a butter croissant on the counter as today's special; the finished social post appears on the phone screen, the owner glances over and smiles. Documentary style, one scene, no logos, minimal text.

messages.text: Here is my business: https://mainstreet-demo-sites.vercel.app/coffee/. What should I try first?

Hi Daniel! Bean & Brick looks great. I saved your profile and four jobs AI could take off your plate: Instagram specials posts, a website chat for questions, review replies, and email or text offers.

I'd try the website chat first. It would answer questions about hours, menu and catering boxes day and night. The tool is Chatling. It's verified by our team, has a free plan, and paid starts at $25 a month. I can set it up for you.

The Instagram posting tools all cost money or need extra steps, so I'd leave them for later.

Want me to set up Chatling? I'll ask for your OK first, and I won't create anything until you give it.
Compare tools for Social posts and specials

I compared three tools for your specials posts. The comparison is saved on your page.

My pick is Apaya. Our team verified it. It writes posts from your website and photos and publishes them to Instagram. It costs from $55 a month, and the 3-day trial asks for a card.

- SocialMe AI: $19 a month, with a 14-day trial and no card. Use it with caution, and its screens can be confusing.
- Promer AI: it has a free plan, but it's built for online stores. Use it with caution. It's a weak fit for you.

We can't set any of these up for you. Apaya's sign-up link is https://apaya.com/pricing. Signing up takes about 20 minutes. For a hand with it, try Maryland SBDC (https://www.marylandsbdc.org).

Would you like a short preview of Apaya?

I already compared these, and the comparison is saved on your page. It covers three tools.

My pick is Chatling. Our team verified it. It has a free plan, and paid plans start at $25 a month. It learns from your website and answers questions about hours, menu and catering boxes day and night. We can set it up for you in about 30 minutes.

- FastBots: it has a free plan with 50 messages a month. Use it with caution. You would have to paste a code into your site yourself.
- Klaviyo: it's better for sending offers than answering questions. Setup takes about 90 minutes.

I compared three tools for review replies. The comparison is saved on your page.

My pick is Super44. Our team verified it. Its free plan watches your Google reviews and helps draft replies. Setup takes about 15 minutes, and paid starts at $19 a month. One caution: its site looks European, and I couldn't confirm it works well for US shops.

- Feedelity: it has a 2-week free trial with no card, then costs from 30 euros a month. Use it with caution. It's made for chains in Europe.
- Sprout Social: review tools need its $199 a month plan. Use it with caution.
